title: Chapter 98: Disobeying Orders Before Battle
content:
Chapter 98: Disobeying Orders Before Battle

Meng saw that Gou Zheng was at a loss for words and began to reveal his true nature, and his goal was achieved.

"Don't make it sound so reasonable to rob the spoils of the allies!"

Meng sneered contemptuously.

Gou Zheng was also a ruthless person. He turned back to the army and ordered to start the siege.

He didn't even consider how many people would die with his order.

"Prepare to attack!"

"Prepare to attack the city!"

"..."

The messenger began to pass the order, and the horn of the whole army's attack was about to sound!

The Zerg army and the elite of the alliance in the city also entered the battle state, and this war between the same camps was about to break out!

"Wait! I have something to say!"

A loud voice sounded, drowning out the voice of the messenger.

In front of the huge square formation of the bull soldiers of the Tengu army, the tall and strong bull lord came out, and it was him who spoke just now.

"Young Master of the Tengu Clan, you can't just start a war between allies in the same camp just because you want to!"

"You hold the token, and we should follow your orders, but I suspect that your token was not obtained through normal means!"

"I want to ask, is it your idea to start this war? Or is it the idea of the Tengu Clan?"

After the lord of the Ox Clan finished speaking, his eyes widened and he stared at Gou Zheng.

Many lords and the entire army seemed to be staring at Gou Zheng, which made Gou Zheng feel great pressure.

But now, he had to bear it.

"Are you doubting me? I am carrying out the mission of the clan! My order represents the will of the clan!"

Gou Zheng pretended to be calm and answered toughly.

"Which adult in the Tengu Clan issued the mission?"

The lord of the Ox Clan continued to ask.

"You are not qualified to know about this matter!"

Although Gou Zheng said toughly, people with discerning eyes have already seen the problem.

"This is a serious matter! We must know which master issued the task!"

The lord of the cattle tribe did not give in. The cattle tribe was notoriously stubborn. When they got angry, they were not afraid of anyone!

Gou Zheng did not dare to answer this question. He held up the token and said loudly: "I have the token in my hand! You know the consequences of refusing to execute the order!"

This sentence was very deterrent to the lords. The consequences of not executing the order were indeed very serious.

The lord of the cattle tribe turned around and faced the army of the Tengu tribe, and said loudly: "Everyone listen to me! This Tengu tribe prince obviously stole the token and wanted to take revenge!"

"If we go to war with our allies in the same camp, the consequences will be serious!"

"These allies were our saviors yesterday! Today, for that unfounded reason, we will fight each other on the battlefield!"

"It's not worth it for us to die here!"

"If it is really necessary to fight this battle! Please ask the adults of the Tengu tribe to come forward and personally issue combat orders!"

After listening to the words of the lord of the cattle tribe, a large group of lords of various tribes stood up and said in unison: "Please come forward, all the lords!"

Gou Zheng was really anxious when he saw this. He turned to the Tengu general and ordered: "You lead two thousand cavalry to attack me!"

"I want to see if those territories have the courage to disobey orders!"

Gou Zheng saw that the Tengu general was a little hesitant, and he said fiercely: "What? You dare to disobey my orders!? You have to think clearly about your identity!"

Hearing this, the Tengu general turned decisively, rushed to the front of the two thousand Tengu cavalry, and ordered loudly: "All cavalry units! Follow me to attack!"

"Kill!"

This special elite cavalry unit of the Tengu launched a charge towards the city occupied by the Zerg!

They knew very well that if they rushed forward with such a small force, they would die. They were just a trigger to attract the Tengu army.

Some lords were indeed led. They did not dare to really disobey the Tengu order and prepared to return to their camp and lead the army to fight.

"Everyone, don't move! If you charge, you will die! If you don't charge, you will just wait here to die!"

"Why waste your energy and go to fight with our savior yesterday?"

"Let's wait here, maybe the result won't be that bad!"

The words of the Bull Lord completely dispelled the desire of the lords to fight.

They felt that the Bull Lord was right. With the combat power shown by the Zerg, they would definitely go to this battle without return. There was no point except to consume some Zerg troops.

It was a death anyway, so it was better to die bravely, so as not to be fooled by a playboy of the Tengu Clan and lose their lives in vain.

The elite cavalry of the Tengu Clan was charging, while the nearly 100,000 troops in the rear stood still, motionless. No matter which army it was, this was an extremely serious case of disobeying orders before the battle, almost the same as rebellion.

Gou Zheng was so angry when he saw this scene that he couldn't speak!

…

“Fight or not?!”

Looking at Wu Qing fiercely, Wu Qing had to make the decision on whether to start a war or not.

“They have come to our doorstep, can we just watch?”

Wu Qing didn’t want to fight, but that didn’t mean he didn’t dare to fight. When he saw Gou Zheng, he was mentally prepared for a big battle.

The current situation is very good. Those lords are very courageous. They directly disobeyed orders on the battlefield, leaving the charging Tengu cavalry alone.

Wu Qing had a very bad impression of the Tengu clan. No matter what the reason was, they had repeatedly provoked him like this, and this time they came directly to his doorstep. Wu Qing was going to teach them a lesson.

"Haha! Good! Let them go without return!"

When the battle started, Meng became excited and no longer cared about the reason and consequences. He just wanted to fight in person.

"You don't need to take action against these cavalry."

Wu Qing saw the charging Tengu cavalry preparing to throw spears, and immediately ordered the hydralisks on the wall to attack.

"That arrogant Tengu general is quite powerful! Leave it to me to deal with it personally!"

Meng said something to Wu Qing, then rode on his giant tiger mount and picked up the cavalry sword.

Wu Qing didn't say anything, which was considered as tacit agreement.

Yu Chong commanded the Yu Clan cavalry archers to draw the longbow.

The hydralisk's spikes whistled towards the Tengu cavalry who wanted to raise their spears and throw them, and knocked down a large number of Tengu knights at once, and many of them turned into light and disappeared directly.

To be an enemy of the Zerg, you are destined to be dead.

Seeing this scene, the lords and soldiers in the rear were a little scared. They were not believers of evil gods, but normal intelligent life forms. They instinctively resisted such an abnormal way of death!

"Shoot!"

Yu Chong gave an order, and a thousand of the most elite archers of the Yu Clan shot the arrows in their hands!

The Tengu cavalry who dodged the volley of hydralisks almost all fell off their mounts in an instant. Although not many of them disappeared directly in light, they had all lost the ability to ride and fight.

The lizard mounts specially cultivated by the Tengu Clan lost the control of the knights and slowly stopped charging. At this moment, only a few people could still sit on the mounts.

"Those mounts are good! Stay! I'll go meet that guy!"

Meng said, and jumped down from the city wall on a giant tiger, and the giant tiger landed steadily.

The hydralisks and Yu Clan archers stopped attacking, and a group of Zerg puppies rushed out from the city gate, following Meng who jumped down to the city, and rushed towards the Tengu Clan cavalry.
